typical_steps: Acknowledge the issue with an expression of empathy or apology
Ask clarifying questions regarding the device, channel, network, and error messages
Direct the customer to troubleshooting steps using a help link
Suggest basic device actions like rebooting the device, modem, or router
Invite the customer to follow up or reach out via phone or chat if the issue persists
info_agent_requests: What channel or network is affected?
Is this during live TV or on-demand?
Are you experiencing the same when trying on wifi?
when_they_escalate_to_dm: Agents invite customers to reach out via phone, chat, or direct message when troubleshooting steps fail to resolve the issue or when they need to gather more account details.
never_promises: guarantees that a specific workaround will instantly fix the issue
